div.div:
v4, draft 2026-11-11
Sources: DAQ VD Fiber Plant v3; "VD onDetector Rack View of Cabling" (TMS, stamped 16SEPT2026); "VD Cryostat 27U Detector Racks" naming drawing (20 N + 20 S racks); "DTS to TDE White Rabbit Synchronisation Interface" (EDMS 3482906, draft v7.0, 26 Oct 2026).
Open items
1. The TMS cabling sheet shows 40GbE MTP-12F per crate (64 active fibers, 6-8 MTP12 per rack). The DAQ baseline drawn here is 25G on an LC pair per crate (16 active fibers, 2 MTP12 per rack); the sheet needs updating to match.
2. The WR interface document leaves the WR Grand Master / DTS interface location open (cryostat area or CUC). Drawn here on the detector mezzanine, fed from the DTS fanout rack on the cryostat roof, with the DTS master in the DAQ barracks.
3. Which mezzanine racks host the WR switches, Grand Masters, DTS interface units and sync-check hardware.
4. L1 uplinks land on a Grand Master or its L2 M extension; the exact port map is not drawn.
5. Two 10G Ctrl uplinks per 27U rack are assumed.
6. Purchase ownership assumed, not confirmed: racks (FDC I&I); patch cord from the 1G switch to the 27U patch panel and the mezzanine Ctrl uplink (FDC I&I); 1G Cu management cables from WR hardware (TDE).
7. Follow-up: who purchases the 2xLC patch cord from the DAQ barracks patch panel to the Ctrl network switch (drawn as DAQ).
8. The patching between the trunk patch panel and the readout switches (top-of-rack patch panels, MTP-12 into 4-way breakout transceivers, per EDMS 3463072) is not drawn in detail.
